site.title: La French Tech Bangkok | French-Thai Tech Community & Events
site.description: La French Tech Bangkok connects French and Thai entrepreneurs — free monthly networking events, talks, and a community of founders, investors and tech leaders.

home.heroTagline: Support your venture with our network
home.mission: Building bridges between the French tech entrepreneurs in Thailand and the local Thai ecosystem
values: Sharing knowledge and helping each other
home.ecosystemHeading: Join a vibrant ecosystem of tech founders, entrepreneurs & business people in Bangkok

pillars.title: Learn new things
pillars.text: La French Tech is a free space for sharing and discovering knowledge. Meet new people, learn from them, develop new ideas

pillars.title: Expand your network
pillars.text: Entrepreneurs, corporates, investors... We have everything to win by getting to know each other.

pillars.title: Grow your business
pillars.text: Build awesome companies, find partners, clients, and purpose

about.intro: La French Tech Bangkok is a volunteer-run community, labelled by La French Tech since 2019. It is free and open to all: French and Thai founders, startups, corporates, investors and anyone who wants to build tech in Thailand.

join.title: Individuals
join.text: Come to our monthly French Tech Connect and Talks, join the WhatsApp group and meet the community.

join.title: Startups
join.text: Get listed in the ecosystem directory and apply for the free French Tech Bangkok membership.

join.title: Business partners
join.text: Support the community, host an event or share your expertise with founders.
